turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with that.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided to enter that zero before anyone picked up a phone.
But I'm not changing the grade.
On what basis? Your own procedure, 4.2, says I'm contacted before any mark is entered, and I wasn't. Show me what you have, or I'm in the principal's office at 4:40.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.

"Still not changing it." I'm writing that down, Hale, word for word, and it goes to the principal with the fact that I've asked twice for your evidence and got nothing. Is anything on Owen's record right now?
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
No to the mark, or no, nothing is on Owen's record? If it's the second, I want that in an email tonight. Either way, Hale, a zero with no evidence shown and no call home goes upstairs today.
